title: Federation probe diagnostic redaction matches the probe directory case-sensitively, so a differently spelled Windows path can reach stderr
outcome: federation_probe_redacted_detail never prints the probe directory on Windows, whatever case, drive-letter, 8.3 short-name or canonical spelling the OS error text uses. The alternative is that the limit is stated where the function is defined.
acceptance: Federation probe diagnostic redaction matches the probe directory case-sensitively, so a differently spelled Windows path can reach stderr is done
